# Map credits

Leaflet 1.9.4 is bundled under its BSD-2-Clause license (LICENSE). The optional detailed street map uses tiles by [OpenStreetMap contributors](https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright).

The bundled geographic background contains information licensed under the [Open Government Licence – Toronto](https://open.toronto.ca/open-data-licence/). Streets, trails, waterways and railway lines are simplified from [Toronto Centreline](https://open.toronto.ca/dataset/toronto-centreline-tcl/). Lakes and rivers come from [Toronto waterbodies](https://open.toronto.ca/dataset/topographic-mapping-waterbodies-and-rivers/). Park polygons come from [Toronto Green Spaces](https://open.toronto.ca/dataset/green-spaces/).
